attchmntText: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has scheduled an investor meeting for 26th November 2026. The notice was issued on 20th November 2026 by Sanjeev Grover, Executive Officer and Company Secretary. The date is subject to change due to exigencies on the part of the investor group or the company. This communication is pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.
